decks.notes: This deck focuses on combining cards to create powerful effects and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Deduce to set up combos and create game-changing plays. The inclusion of counterspells like Negate helps protect your combos and maintain control of the game. Vaultborn Tyrant and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide unique win conditions, while cards like Phantom Interference and Torch the Tower offer versatility and surprise elements. Overall, the deck aims to surprise and overwhelm opponents with its creative combinations and strategic plays.

This deck is focused on quickly overwhelming the opponent with an aggressive strategy using Artifact creatures and spells. By leveraging cards like Ensoul Artifact and Shrapnel Blast, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and close out matches swiftly. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a Companion provides additional value and benefits to the overall game plan. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Spyglass Siren and Spell Pierce to control the game and protect its key threats.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Amalia Benavides Aguirre as the key piece. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company, the deck can quickly search for and play important combo pieces. The deck also includes cards like Aetherflux Reservoir and Wildgrowth Walker to gain life and stay alive long enough to execute the combo. Additionally, the presence of cards like Selfless Savior and Skyclave Apparition provide protection and removal options to ensure the combo goes off smoothly.

This deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo, utilizing cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan, such as Thoughseize and Bitter Triumph, while also including utility cards like Raffine's Informant and Witherbloom Command. The mana base is designed to support the combo pieces and enable a smooth game plan. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and dominate the battlefield with powerful creatures and game-ending plays.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while using cards like Waste Not to gain value from their discards. Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred help to control the board, while Field of Ruin deals with problematic lands. Go Blank and Castle Locthwain provide card advantage, and cards like Fatal Push and Extinction Event help to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through control and resource management.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a wide range of powerful and versatile spells, while also utilizing the Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a key card for card advantage and selection. It also incorporates Bring to Light to search for specific answers or threats, as well as Leyline Binding for more control options. The inclusion of Omnath, Locus of Creation and various Gods provides additional win conditions and value, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad offers additional versatility and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outcontrol opponents to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing versatile cards like Bring to Light, Leyline Binding, and Vanishing Verse to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By running a wide range of multicolored cards, including powerful planeswalkers like Niv-Mizzet Reborn and Omnath, Locus of Creation, the deck maximizes its options for different situations. With Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck gains additional value through blinking creatures and permanents for additional card advantage and battlefield presence. The goal is to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through careful resource management and strategic plays.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and quick damage output. The deck utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Bloodtithe Harvester to push damage early on, while also incorporating disruption with cards like Duress, Thoughtseize, and removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. Additionally, Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord can provide additional aggression and support for the deck's creatures, while Archfiend of the Dross and Vein Ripper offer powerful threats to close out games quickly. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of creatures, disruption, and removal.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo with Amalia Benavides Aguirre and a combination of creatures and spells to gain life and create a powerful board state. The key strategy involves using cards like Aetherflux Reservoir, Chord of Calling, and Collected Company to bring together the necessary pieces for the combo. The deck also includes cards like Sentinel of the Nameless City and Lunarch Veteran to help gain life and protect the combo pieces. Overall, the goal is to establish a strong life gain engine while utilizing Amalia Benavides Aguirre's abilities to win the game.

The deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with small, aggressive creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Hopeful Initiate, supported by cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Brave the Elements to pump them up and protect them. It also includes disruptive elements like Containment Priest and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to slow down opponents. Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale provide additional creature threats, while cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Brutal Cathar help protect key creatures. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with a fast, efficient aggro strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play aggressive artifact creatures and use various spells and abilities to enhance them, deal damage to the opponent's creatures, and ultimately win the game by attacking aggressively. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds another layer of consistency to the deck, allowing for a more streamlined strategy. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures, artifact enhancements, and direct damage spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly setting up a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck utilizes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper to apply pressure and close out the game swiftly. Additionally, cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and synergies within the deck. By combining aggression and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory in a fast-paced Pioneer 1vs1 match.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. It aims to do this through efficient draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Consider, while also using disruptive spells like Fiery Impulse and Spell Pierce to control the board. The deck also includes Hall of Storm Giants to provide a powerful finisher, along with other utility cards like Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and cheap creatures, while utilizing the graveyard as a resource.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand and board state while utilizing powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly close out the game. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act, while also using Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to provide additional value and aggression. The mana base is streamlined to support the aggressive game plan, with a mix of dual lands and creature lands to ensure consistency in both mana production and damage output.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly get Arclight Phoenix into play and deal damage to the opponent using aggressive spells and creatures. The deck focuses on cycling through cards with cantrips like Opt and Consider to fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries, allowing for the easy return of Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. It also includes disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Ashiok, Dream Render to control the opponent's resources. The deck aims to outpace the opponent with quick, aggressive plays and efficient removal.

This aggressive red deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures with high damage potential and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Ghitu Lavarunner along with efficient spells such as Skewer the Critics and Wizard's Lightning, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. Cards like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear provide additional sources of damage, while cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Kumano Faces Kakkazan offer extra utility and potential removal options.
